text: Gayatri Devi is worshipped as Vedamata, the Mother of the Vedas, and as the embodiment of wisdom and divine brilliance.
What is special about Gayatri Devi?
The Gayatri Mantra is one of the most sacred Vedic mantras in our tradition.
In this mantra, meditating upon the divine radiance of Lord Savitr, we pray that He guide our intellect along the righteous path.
That is why Gayatri worship is not merely about asking for desires…
It is also about seeking that our thoughts move in the right direction.
In traditional depictions, Gayatri Devi is shown with five faces.
Some spiritual traditions assign profound philosophical meanings to these five faces, such as the Panchabhutas (five elements) and Panchapranas (five vital breaths).
Just as it is important for a person to possess knowledge, it is equally important to use that knowledge in the right way.
That is why what we seek in the Gayatri prayer is not just cleverness… but the divine grace that guides us toward noble thoughts.
Today, meditating upon Mother Gayatri, let us pray that She blesses us with a noble intellect, knowledge, and wisdom.
Wisdom guides that power in the right direction.
